requirements.R-ABORT-RO: start-up aborts before ANY write to the store: every input file byte-identical after the attempt (sha256 equal), no rename, no .bak rotation, no settings write; the refusal is reported out-of-band (process exit code + boot incident log outside the store)
requirements.R-NO-MANAGE: no AccountContext is created for the account: no order, cancel, stop repair, reconcile booking or journal write is issued; protective orders already on the exchange are left untouched
requirements.R-EVIDENCE: the damaged bytes are preserved bit-for-bit (copy-then-mark, never move-then-rewrite) and linked from a durable incident record that survives restarts
requirements.R-DURABLE-FAIL: the failed-closed condition is itself durable: a restart (with or without intervening saves) returns to the same blocked state until an explicit reconciliation record exists
requirements.R-RECON-GATE: management (and every new-risk path, MANUAL included) stays blocked until a reconciliation record binds state generation G to an exchange snapshot that matches it (positions, open orders, protective orders) or the owner adopts/flattens each difference explicitly; resuming entries alone never clears it
requirements.R-NO-EMPTY: an initialized account (marker or any store generation or evidence present) can never load as an empty portfolio; an empty portfolio is only legal for a first run whose exchange snapshot is flat (no positions, no open orders) or after an explicit owner adoption record
requirements.R-BACKUP-CANDIDATE: an older generation (backup) is offered as a reconciliation CANDIDATE, never silently promoted to managed state; it becomes managed only after R-RECON-GATE passes against the exchange
requirements.R-FIRST-RUN-FLAT: first-run initialization requires a successful exchange snapshot; a non-flat account blocks initialization until the owner adopts or closes each position/order explicitly
requirements.R-GEN-MONOTONIC: every store write carries (generation, writer_build, format_version, min_reader_version); a reader that sees a generation written by a newer build, or a lower generation than the highest it has seen (rollback/stale copy), aborts read-only (R-ABORT-RO)
requirements.R-SINGLE-SOURCE: the account marker, the store and its backups are one versioned unit: one invalid member blocks the unit; a backup can never silently clear an owner-confirmation requirement
